text.en:
Kills with Black Armory Weapons, or readying a Black Armory weapon within 7 seconds of any weapon kill, grants 'Forge's Kin'. Maximum of 3 stacks. Timer begins upon readying the weapon and cannot be refreshed.

Equipping and performing the above conditions with additional Black Armory weapons increases the potency and duration of the buff. 

Forge's Kin provides the following benefits with 1|2|3 Black Armory Weapons equipped:
• 5|7|9 Second Buff Duration 
• 15|?|? Reload Speed 
• ?|?|? Ammo Generation 
• 0%|5% (#e 7%)|10% (#e 13%) Increased Damage Against Combatants

The exotic weapons <yellow Izanagi's Burden, Jötunn, and Le Monarque /> count as Black Armory weapons for the purposes of the origin trait, but do not recieve its benefits.
